feeds.title: Nicholas Hacko Watchmaker Blog
feeds.description: Nicholas Hacko Watchmaker Blog updates you with all the information on the watches, their important parts, how its made, dial manufacturing, and a complete guide to Mk2 dial part 3! Nicholas Hacko is a watch dealer and watchmaker in Sydney, Australia.

feeds.title: Watch Ya Gonna Do About It
feeds.description: Watch Ya Gonna Do About It is a new website for Luxury Watch reviews. We review high-end luxury watches for the Grail Collector. We only review watches we personally like, not all brands, and all watches from brands are covered. It is a passion project, aimed at creating horological content that is honest, genuine, and non-commercial. Our USP is simply us.

feeds.title: Watch Advice
feeds.description: Watch Advice is founded on the basic love and appreciation for watches of all kinds. Our aim is to become Australia's number one new watch website. Our blog provides luxury watch reviews, news, information, and advice.

feeds.title: Time and Tide Watches
feeds.description: Time+Tide is one of the world's leading publishers of watch content. We publish a minimum of three stories a day on the website, a regular stream of videos on YouTube, and whenever and whatever we feel like on social media. We approach watches with an open mind. We are all about opening up the conversation and giving you advice that has value.

feeds.title: Watch Direct News
feeds.description: Check out the Watch Direct Australia Blog for the latest design and luxury watch news, information, and guides! We provide quality watches at an affordable price. Our mission is pretty simple. We're committed to bringing you the top global brands in watches at affordable prices. We offer our customers an incredible range of watches, stocking hundreds of watches from more than 40 brands. From your everyday watches to our premium choices, all our watches are authentic and brand new.

feeds.title: Bausele Blog
feeds.description: Discover the latest from Bausele like blog articles on Sydney artists at its event, Bausele global watch event, and many more! The Bausele watch brand was begun in 2011 in Sydney, Australia by Founder, Christophe Hoppe. It was born out of his passion for Australia and his extensive background in the Swiss watch industry. They believe in 'you work hard and play harder'. Whether you're on the beach or in the boardroom, you want to be your best and look your best.

feeds.title: Define Watches
feeds.description: Define Watches is Australia's leading independent-brand watch retailer. Specializing in premium men's and women's timepieces, we offer an extensive collection of the finest and most unique watches online and in-store. Because of our passion for quality craftsmanship and excellent value, we carefully curate our watch collections to bring you the very best from independent Swiss, German, and Austrian independent watchmakers, creating a new benchmark in bespoke luxury.

feeds.title: Adina Watches Blog
feeds.description: Adina Watches Blog provides an engaging look into the background stories of how Australia's last watch producer Adina watches keeps the inspiration. Adina Watches is 'The Company of Australian Watchmakers'. It has high-quality wrist watches designed and assembled by hand.

feeds.title: Downunder Watches Blog
feeds.description: The watches that Australians wear on their wrist matters to them and this is why downunderwatches.com brings to its lovely Australian customers, the very latest and best in watch design, accuracy, and functionality. We are a trusted dealer for all the watches we stock, you can be assured that each and every watch is official and comes with a worldwide warranty.

feeds.title: The Hour Glass
feeds.description: At The Hour Glass, our mission is to advance watch culture. Known for our thoughtfully curated selection of brands, a passion for designing uniquely immersive retail experiences, and our team of highly knowledgeable watch specialists, we strive to become the primary port of call for all watch enthusiasts and collectors alike. Read all the featured stories, latest news, and information on all the Australian watches and more!
